facts.business: Atul Limited operates in Life Science Chemicals and Performance and Other Chemicals segments with nine sub-segments including Aromatics, Bulk Chemicals and Intermediates, Colors, Crop Protection – Bulk Actives, Crop Protection – Retail, Floras, Pharmaceuticals, Polymers – Performance Materials and Polymers – Retail.
key_risks: Climate change represents a principal risk to the Company
Manufacturing operations require significant water and may experience direct or indirect impacts due to water scarcity
